scope: Adjacent versus separated surface Ag atoms in the tested periodic clean-slab model.
supported_conclusion: The separated Ag configuration has lower calculated energy across the tested clean-slab model comparisons.
unsupported_conclusions: SEP is globally the most stable configuration.
SEP is more active for CO2 reduction.
The DFT reference is fully converged.
scientific_limitations: Only NN and SEP configurations are compared.
Clean-slab energies do not predict ethylene selectivity.
Models have not been validated for electrochemical potential.
DFT cutoff convergence at dense k-points is incomplete.
DFT structures have not been geometry-optimized.
Finite-size and periodic-image effects remain untested.
Agreement across models is not a statistical uncertainty.
agent_instructions: Use this evidence only for the specified Cu(100) clean-slab comparison.
Do not infer CO2RR activity or ethylene FE.
Do not describe the DFT results as fully converged.
Do not generalize this comparison to 100 nm Ag-island catalyst designs.
Distinguish computed energies from experimentally measured results.
Recommend further validation before making performance claims.
